title: AlgoHar
rule: This passport is a release gate projection, not evidence. Unknown/stale/fail remains blocking for applicable public release gates.

exposure_classified.evidence: Consumer web product with planned payments and authenticated paid entitlement.
exposure_classified.next_action: Keep tier current if product boundaries change.

threat_model_current.next_action: Bind a current reviewed threat model for V2 public, payment and entitlement surfaces.

public_private_boundary.evidence: docs/product-manifest.json and docs/ip-clean-room.md define V2/public and legacy/private boundaries.

authentication_secure_if_applicable.next_action: Verify authenticated learner/account flow when production auth is enabled.

authorization_least_privilege_if_applica.next_action: Verify paid entitlement authorization and revocation against durable production state.

session_cookie_csrf_controls_if_applicab.next_action: Verify cookie/session and CSRF behavior in the selected production auth deployment.

secret_and_key_handling.evidence: Tracked BackEnd/.env removed in release-adoption branch and .env files are now ignored; historical secret rotation/exposure review is still required before production.
secret_and_key_handling.next_action: Run tracked secret scan and rotate any credential that was ever real; keep production secrets environment/provider-only.

no_default_credentials.next_action: Verify production configuration contains no default credentials.

input_validation_and_output_encoding.next_action: Bind current API/input validation evidence for all production endpoints.

rate_limits_and_abuse_controls.evidence: docs/launch-readiness.md explicitly leaves production abuse controls open.
rate_limits_and_abuse_controls.next_action: Select and verify production rate/abuse controls at hosting boundary.

anti_spam_and_external_communication_pol.evidence: docs/product-manifest.json forbids fake testimonials, scraped audiences, bought engagement and mass unsolicited DMs.
anti_spam_and_external_communication_pol.next_action: Keep growth channels inside approved policy.

cors_csp_security_headers_if_web.evidence: Baseline headers exist, but production hosting evidence is absent.
cors_csp_security_headers_if_web.next_action: Verify final CSP/CORS/security headers on deployed HTTPS origin.

tls_and_domain_identity_if_public.evidence: docs/launch-readiness.md: owned domain + HTTPS not yet verified.
tls_and_domain_identity_if_public.next_action: Provision owned domain and verify HTTPS identity.

pii_minimization.evidence: Manifest defines aggregate analytics intent; production processors and retention remain unresolved.
pii_minimization.next_action: Verify minimal production data collection and real processor/retention disclosures.

data_retention_and_deletion.next_action: Define and verify production retention/deletion for learner, lead, analytics and payment-linked data.

logs_redacted_and_auditable.next_action: Verify production logs exclude credentials, raw payment data and unnecessary PII.

dependency_lock_and_provenance.evidence: docs/launch-readiness.md marks reproducible full dependency graph incomplete.
dependency_lock_and_provenance.next_action: Establish and verify release lock/provenance for V2.

dependency_vulnerability_review.next_action: Run current dependency vulnerability review on exact release candidate.

sast_or_equivalent_static_security_analy.next_action: Bind current static security analysis for exact candidate.

secret_scan.evidence: Manifest requires tracked-file secret scan; current exact release-candidate evidence not bound here.
secret_scan.next_action: Run and bind secret scan on exact candidate after tracked .env removal.

test_typecheck_lint_build.evidence: docs/launch-readiness.md records exact-head V2 CI source evidence for catalog/practice/semantics/typecheck/lint/build/browser QA.
test_typecheck_lint_build.next_action: Re-run exact-head CI for every release candidate.

api_contract_and_error_safety.next_action: Verify production API contracts and safe failure behavior.

resource_limits_timeouts_backpressure.evidence: Analytics timeout fail-closed behavior exists; full production boundary is not verified.
resource_limits_timeouts_backpressure.next_action: Verify timeouts/resource bounds for all public production endpoints.

idempotency_and_replay_safety.evidence: Payment transition/outbox contracts exist in source, but durable production DB/webhook path is not implemented.
idempotency_and_replay_safety.next_action: Verify idempotency and replay safety with durable production payment storage/webhook/reconciliation.

backup_boundary_if_stateful.next_action: Define backup boundary for durable account/payment/progress state before production.

restore_or_recovery_evidence_if_stateful.next_action: Produce restore/recovery evidence for production durable state.

rollback_path.evidence: docs/product-manifest.json and docs/launch-readiness.md define checkout disable and redeploy-last-verified-build recovery semantics.
rollback_path.next_action: Verify rollback on the actual hosting/payment deployment.

incident_response_owner_and_runbook.next_action: Bind production incident-response owner/runbook before release.

observability_without_sensitive_leakage.next_action: Verify production health/funnel/payment observability without sensitive payload leakage.

exact_head_ci.evidence: Historical exact-head evidence exists in docs/launch-readiness.md; no exact release candidate is selected in docs/release-profile.json.
exact_head_ci.next_action: Select candidate SHA and bind current exact-head CI.

independent_security_review.next_action: Complete independent security review for payment/auth/public release candidate.

staging_acceptance.next_action: Run staging acceptance with production-like payment/auth/data boundaries.

live_post_deploy_security_probe.next_action: Run live security/functional probes after authorized deployment.
